product_overview: BKI Academy Certificate Management System is an internal operations app for tracking training batches and managing the full certificate lifecycle from generation through completion. It gives admins, certificate staff, and managers visibility into status, bottlenecks, audit history, and reminders.
core_goals: Track training batches and their participants
Monitor certificate status across the full workflow
Assign PIC responsibility for training batches
Provide operational dashboard visibility for managers
Maintain an activity history and audit trail
Surface overdue items and certificate delays

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users sign in to access the internal certificate management system and reach authenticated pages.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in email address -> Fill in password -> Submit sign in form -> See dashboard

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Users view an operational snapshot of training completion, certificate progress, overdue items, completion rate, pipeline status, and recent activity.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Review KPI cards and pipeline summary -> Review recent activity entries

features.name: Training Management
features.description: Users manage training batches, including viewing the training list and creating a new training record.
user_flows: Navigate to /trainings -> Review the training list -> Search or filter the list -> Open the add training flow -> Enter training name, batch, dates, PIC, and status -> Create the training record -> See the new training appear in the list

features.name: Training Detail and Participant Tracking
features.description: Users open a training batch to inspect participants and track certificate progress at the batch level.
user_flows: Navigate to /trainings -> Open a training batch -> Review overview metrics -> Review the participant list -> Review participant certificate statuses

features.name: Certificate Kanban Workflow Tracking
features.description: Users track certificates within a training batch and move them through workflow statuses from pending to completed.
user_flows: Navigate to /trainings -> Open a training batch -> Open the certificates view -> Select a certificate card -> Drag the card to another workflow column -> Confirm the status change -> See the card move to the new status and the workflow update

features.name: Certificate Detail and Status Update
features.description: Users inspect a specific certificate’s current status, timeline, and notes, then update its progress.
user_flows: Navigate to /trainings -> Open a training batch -> Open a certificate card -> Review participant details, certificate type, timeline, and notes -> Update the certificate status -> Confirm the change -> See the updated timeline and status

features.name: Global Certificate Monitoring
features.description: Users monitor all certificates in one place with filters for training, type, status, PIC, and date.
user_flows: Navigate to /certificates -> Review the certificate table -> Apply filters by training, type, status, PIC, or date -> Review matching certificates and their ages

features.name: Activity History and Audit Trail
features.description: Users review system history for certificate movements and training updates.
user_flows: Navigate to /history-logs -> Review audit trail entries -> Open a training batch -> Open the activity log view -> Review newly created history entries after certificate status changes

features.name: Reports and Analytics
features.description: Managers review operational reporting on completion time, overdue certificates, total certificate volume, and performance trends.
user_flows: Navigate to /reports -> Review summary cards -> Review charts for monthly completion, delay reasons, and PIC performance

features.name: Profile Settings
features.description: Users update their profile name and department information.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings/profile -> Update name or department -> Save changes -> Review the updated profile information

features.name: Notification Preferences
features.description: Users adjust how they receive application notifications.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings/notifications -> Review notification preference options -> Change preference settings -> Save changes -> Review the updated notification settings

features.name: Security Settings
features.description: Users change their password and manage security-related account settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings/security -> Enter current password -> Enter a new password -> Confirm the new password -> Save security changes -> See the password update complete

features.name: System Configuration
features.description: Users configure standard SLA processing days and register new staff in the system.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings/system -> Review system configuration settings -> Update standard SLA processing days -> Add new staff information -> Save changes -> See the updated system settings

routes.description: Dashboard overview with key KPIs and recent activities
Training detail page with certificate Kanban Board and Audit Trail
Global certificate monitoring list with filter and CSV export
Reports and analytics detailing SLA compliance
Password updates and Multi-factor Authentication mock setup
Configure Standard SLA processing days and register new staff
